title: Hesperidin Attenuates H(2)O(2)-Induced Neurotoxicity via Modulation of Inflammatory Pathways and MMP Activity in Differentiated SH-SY5Y Cells: In Vitro and In Silico Models.
authors: Eciroglu-Sarban, Hamiyet; Yildiz, Fatma; Kocanci, Fatma Gonca; Altin-Celik, Pinar; Derya-Andeden, Muazzez
journal: Journal of biochemical and molecular toxicology
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨橙皮苷对氧化应激诱导的神经毒性的保护作用，分子对接仅针对炎症蛋白（COX-2、TNF-α），不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Chronic inflammation, often aggravated by oxidative stress, is a key contributor to the pathogenesis of neurodegenerative diseases. Molecular mediators such as NF-kappaB, COX-2, pro-inflammatory cytokines, and matrix metalloproteinases (MMP-2/MMP-9) disrupt blood-brain barrier (BBB) integrity and promote neuronal damage. Hesperidin, a natural citrus flavonoid with low cytotoxicity and high antioxidant capacity, has shown promise as a neuroprotective agent. This study aimed to evaluate its anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective effects in differentiated SH-SY5Y neuroblastoma cells exposed to hydrogen peroxide (H(2)O(2)), a well-established inducer of oxidative neurotoxicity. The protective effects of Hesperidin (75 and 100 microM for 48 h), administered as both pre- and post-treatment, were evaluated through cell viability assays, assessment of oxidative stress parameters, and expression analysis of inflammatory mediators (TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6, NF-kappaB, COX-2), and MMP-2/MMP-9, using ELISA and RT-qPCR. In silico molecular docking analyses were also conducted using CB-Dock2 Tools to support the experimental findings. In our results, Hesperidin significantly increased cell viability (p < 0.001) and reduced morphological damage. It also downregulated TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and IL-6 at both mRNA and protein levels (p < 0.05-0.005), while markedly suppressing NF-kappaB, COX-2, MMP-2, and MMP-9 expression (p < 0.01-0.005) and decreasing oxidative stress (p < 0.005). Molecular docking revealed strong binding affinities of Hesperidin to key inflammatory targets, particularly COX-2 (-12.2 kcal/mol) and TNF-alpha (-11.6 kcal/mol). These findings indicate that Hesperidin exerts potent neuroprotective effects against H(2)O(2)-induced oxidative stress and neuroinflammation by modulating pro-inflammatory signaling pathways, matrix metalloproteinase activity, and redox homeostasis. These results highlight Hesperidin's potential as a therapeutic candidate for neurodegenerative disorders.
abstract_zh: 慢性炎症常因氧化应激而加剧，是神经退行性疾病发病机制中的关键因素。NF-kappaB、COX-2、促炎细胞因子及基质金属蛋白酶（MMP-2/MMP-9）等分子介质破坏血脑屏障（BBB）完整性并促进神经元损伤。橙皮苷（Hesperidin）是一种天然柑橘类黄酮，具有低细胞毒性和高抗氧化能力，已显示出作为神经保护剂的潜力。本研究旨在评估其在暴露于过氧化氢（H(2)O(2)）（一种公认的氧化性神经毒性诱导剂）的分化SH-SY5Y神经母细胞瘤细胞中的抗炎和神经保护作用。通过细胞活力测定、氧化应激参数评估以及炎症介质（TNF-alpha、IL-1beta、IL-6、NF-kappaB、COX-2）和MMP-2/MMP-9的表达分析（采用ELISA和RT-qPCR），评估了橙皮苷（75和100 microM，处理48小时）作为预处理和后处理给药时的保护效果。还使用CB-Dock2工具进行了计算机分子对接分析，以支持实验结果。我们的结果显示，橙皮苷显著提高细胞活力（p < 0.001）并减少形态损伤。它在mRNA和蛋白质水平上下调TNF-alpha、IL-1beta和IL-6（p < 0.05-0.005），同时显著抑制NF-kappaB、COX-2、MMP-2和MMP-9的表达（p < 0.01-0.005），并降低氧化应激（p < 0.005）。分子对接显示橙皮苷与关键炎症靶点具有强结合亲和力，特别是COX-2（-12.2 kcal/mol）和TNF-alpha（-11.6 kcal/mol）。这些发现表明，橙皮苷通过调节促炎信号通路、基质金属蛋白酶活性和氧化还原稳态，对H(2)O(2)诱导的氧化应激和神经炎症发挥强效神经保护作用。这些结果凸显了橙皮苷作为神经退行性疾病治疗候选药物的潜力。
